selected_dna_emulation.scope: one representative DNA test per infection event
selected_dna_emulation.selection_rule: earliest DNA test with at least one selected positive-read measurement; otherwise lowest source test_number, then seq_id
selected_dna_emulation.observation_rule: selected=true and reads>0 in the representative DNA test

constraints: The original manually selected DNA file is unavailable for these cohorts, so this is a deterministic selected-DNA emulation rather than a historical replay.
The emulation rule is answer blind and identical for every patient.
The legacy scorer receives exactly one DNA test per infection event and receives no RNA or cross-test reproducibility evidence.
Missing clinical evidence is unknown and is never interpreted as negative evidence.
The parent release taxonomy, history, healthcare-device Priority route, Picked gate, and four output labels remain unchanged.
The reporting repair emits one primary organism per patient whenever at least one candidate exists; low-confidence fallback does not become a formal Picked label.
Answers are opened only after the 22-patient decision freeze is persisted.
The clinical11 labels and cases were previously inspected, and the mngs_only11 subset lacks complete clinical modalities; results are compatibility evidence, not untouched external validation.
